artworks.title: A Drinking Child with Resting Peasants
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 13 × 17.3 cm (5 1/8 × 6 13/16 in.), trimmed to or within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures. At the center, a seated woman holds a child on her back. Beside her, another seated female figure is visible. In the foreground, a man with shaggy hair rests against a stone or log. In the left background, a person attends to a donkey drinking from a trough. The backdrop includes architectural elements and a foliaged landscape with a classical appearance, seen in strong lines and shadows typical of a print.

artworks.title: The Dream of Saint Joseph
artworks.description: This is an image of a group of figures under a rustic structure. An angelic figure with outstretched wings points towards a seated man, while another figure behind them holds a small child. In the background, there are a few animals, including a goat and an ox. The setting includes architectural elements like columns and arches. Fine lines and shading are used to create texture and depth, emphasizing a moment of revelation or divine communication.

artworks.title: Flight into Egypt
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 28.52 cm (11 1/4 in.), trimmed within platemark
mount: 34.7 × 28.5 cm (13 11/16 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with a traveler, a woman carrying a child, and a donkey. The drawing depicts a serene landscape with a detailed foreground. There is a figure leading a donkey across a stone bridge over a small stream. The person is holding the reins of the donkey, whose head is slightly lowered. Adjacent to them is a woman cloaked in drapery, holding a child securely in her arms, and they are partially concealed by lush foliage. Behind them, the landscape is marked by elegantly drawn trees with plentiful leaves and distant rocky formations, adding depth to the scene. The scene captures a gentle, quiet moment set against a backdrop of undulating hills and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Holy Family Seated on an Arch
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 19.6 × 28.7 cm (7 11/16 × 11 5/16 in.), trimmed to platemark
artworks.description: The image shows five figures in various positions. A bearded man is seated and leaning on a staff, supporting his head with one hand. Beside him is a woman seated with her body turned slightly to the right. Two children are sitting on a stone ledge, one facing forward and the other reaching out towards a sheep. The setting includes large stone pillars on the left, a stone building with a rounded tower behind the figures, and various architectural elements. In the background, there is a bare tree on the right and clouds in the sky. The scene is rendered in a classical style with emphasis on line work and shading.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded man walking alongside a woman holding a child, with a donkey in the scene. The drawing features the figures in classical attire with flowing robes and head coverings. The man has a careful stride and is holding a walking stick. The woman is on the donkey, holding a child. The background shows trees and hills. The style is detailed with refined linework depicting a narrative moment.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Baptizing the Eunuch
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing figures and a horse. Several figures are depicted in what seems to be a significant moment, with a group under a tree in the foreground. A horse is included on the right, and the background displays dramatic cloud formations. Architectural elements are visible on the left. The drawing exhibits detailed line work typical of engravings depicting historic events.

artworks.title: Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure ascending towards a heavenly realm surrounded by cherubic angels and divine light. Below, a group of figures appears to be witnessing or reacting to the event with expressions of awe and reverence. The detailing and cross-hatching techniques convey depth and drama, capturing the movement and celestial atmosphere of the scene. The border and composition suggest a baroque influence in style.

artworks.title: Descent from the Cross
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a figure being lowered from a cross. The composition includes dense figures in various poses. At the top center, a person is handling the cross, while others below tend to the central figure. The drawing is rich with detailed lines, creating a somber mood. The setting appears dark, with the focus on the action of descending and mourning. The arrangement of light and shadow enhances the emotional gravity of the scene.

artworks.title: The Crowning of the Virgin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with figures and angels. In the image, there is a composition showing a divine event among the clouds. Several angelic beings surround a central figure who is being crowned. Above, there is a triangular representation with an eye. The figures are shown with flowing drapery, giving the composition movement. Crosshatching and line work add texture and depth to the drawing.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a figure on a cross, with another figure kneeling at the base, and additional figures in the background, adjoined by a horse, underneath a dramatic, swirling sky. The composition is detailed, with hatch-lined shading creating contrast and depth, highlighting the figures and the texture of the terrain. The elements in the background provide an atmospheric context to the scene.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Bacchus with Dancing Nymphs
artworks.description: The image shows dynamic lines and curves forming an abstract composition of entwined human figures. The figures appear to be dancing, with arched and extended limbs. In the background, there are abstract shapes resembling musicians and bacchanalian elements such as wine barrels and grapevines. The overall scene suggests a festive atmosphere of celebration.

artworks.title: The Education of Satyr Children
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting various mythological figures interacting within a detailed scene. The composition features an assembly of figures, some appearing humanoid, while others have exaggerated features like horns and goat-like legs. The central figure is a standing male figure carrying children, surrounded by others in various poses. On the right side of the image, another humanoid figure interacts with additional characters. The background is filled with dynamic lines and cross-hatching, creating an intense and textured atmosphere. The image is rich in fine details, showcasing intricate patterns and shading, giving life to what appears to be a narrative or mythological scene filled with motion and emotion.

artworks.title: Das Feur / Le Feu (Fire)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person standing in an elaborate architectural setting with ornate scrollwork and floral motifs. The drawing illustrates a figure set amidst an intricately detailed Baroque style design. The figure stands with one foot forward, gesturing upwards, surrounded by swirling architectural columns and plant-like decorations. Above and around the person, there's a mixture of shell and foliage designs. The lower section of the drawing contains text in a stylistic script.

artworks.title: Presentation in the Temple
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered, including a man holding a wrapped child in his arms. A woman stands beside him, while another woman sitting reaches out toward the child. In the foreground, two young boys attend to a large vase. The background features architectural elements like pillars and a domed archway.

artworks.title: Love Mourns at the Tomb of Preacher Bruhn (Am Grabmal des predigers Bruhn trauert die eheliche Liebe)
artworks.medium: etching, roulette and stipple on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure seated beside a large medallion. The artwork features a figure draped in classical robes, seated beside a large circular medallion. The medallion displays a profile relief of a figure, with the letters "ORB.E..." visible on the circumference. The scene includes foliage in the background, a textured trunk and branches overhanging from the left, and scrolls and floral decorations on the right side in the foreground. The drawing demonstrates meticulous cross-hatching and line work for depth and shading.

artworks.title: The Goddess of Fame Placing a Laurel Wreath on the Memorial to General Keith
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure seated on an ornate architectural element. The drawing depicts a winged figure seated on a large, intricately decorated urn. The figure holds a laurel wreath and has a trumpet resting at the base. The background showcases an arched design.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. It depicts a central wooden cross with a figure crucified upon it, surrounded by onlookers. The crucified figure appears calm. In the lower left, several figures are kneeling in garments resembling Roman military attire. To the right, figures draped in robes appear sorrowful or contemplative, looking at the central figure. The background is lightly sketched, providing context to the gathering. The lines are finely etched, giving texture and contrast to the scene, capturing the moment in a detailed, illustrative style.

artworks.title: Antique Sacrifice
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding an altar inside a large tent. The scene is in monochrome, using shading and line work to create depth and texture. The figures, dressed in robes, seem to be engaged in a ritual. Some figures hold objects like a torch or vessels. The interior of the tent is draped and embellished with garlands, adding to the atmosphere. The drawing conveys a sense of worship, tradition, and perhaps an invocation of higher powers.

artworks.title: Bust of a Monk
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper mounted on buff paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching on a sheet of paper depicting a profile view of a man from the shoulders up. The man is positioned in a slight three-quarter profile facing to the right. He has distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose and defined jawline, with a balding head that has a fringe of closely cut hair. The man is wearing a garment that appears to have a high collar or draped fabric around his neck. The etching is placed on a plain, speckled paper background, which is minimally textured, and has sparse markings, including a signature "Schonfeld" and a potential numbering in the lower right corner of the paper.

artworks.title: Vincent Barthélémy
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man from the thighs up, facing forward. He has a long, pointed nose, a prominent mustache, and full, curly hair reaching his shoulders. He is wearing a dark, richly-textured garment with wide, lace-trimmed sleeves and a square white collar. His right arm is resting on a cushioned chair arm, while his left arm is holding a rolled object in his lap. He is surrounded by an oval frame with decorative motifs, inscriptions, and a small crest. The background has a plain, textured pattern within the frame.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, laid down on old album sheet
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with a slightly turned posture. The person's facial features include a long beard and wavy hair. They are dressed in a flowing robe with an additional cloak wrapped around the shoulders. The person is barefoot, holding a book in one hand and a long staff or cross in the other. The background features a textured surface with a horizontal pattern for depth.

artworks.title: Saint Luke Painting the Virgin
artworks.artist: Raphael Sadeler I, after Bartholomaeus Spranger
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a long beard and wavy hair seated at an easel, engaged in painting or drawing. He is in a slightly reclined position, using one hand to gesture and the other to hold a brush. He wears a long robe that drapes over the chair. Winged figures, including angels, are around him, with one standing beside him and others in the background. In the upper part of the image, a celestial scene unfolds with a woman holding a child, surrounded by clouds and cherubs. The setting features clouds and rays of light illuminating the upper part, contrasting with the detailed figures below.

artworks.title: Landscape with Duck Hunters
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 21.8 × 31.6 cm (8 9/16 × 12 7/16 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a landscape with a woodland scene viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is positioned about halfway up the image, with open fields and a few scattered trees stretching into the distance. The left side shows a dense cluster of trees with full canopies, while the right side features two figures, possibly hunters, with dogs among foliage. The brushstrokes are precise, with detailed crosshatching techniques used for textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of black and grey. In the distance, an open and expansive landscape is bordered by a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Young Woman Seated in a Garden
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a bench. She has delicate facial features, with a prominent nose and a contemplative expression, gazing to her left. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo. She is wearing a dress with puffed sleeves and a fur collar. The background is lush with large leaves and blooming flowers. No jewelry or objects are visible in her hands.
